name: gauge_demo
description: Demo-pairing example (PROMPT_FORMAT.md section 6b): the same data_quality kit flag with DEMO_IMAGES=1, so the gauge V# row comes from an illustrative kit sample image (pairing demo), not from this asset. The orchestrator sends no logged reading for a demo image, so the row has no logged_id/delta/agrees and System 2 drops them if they are sent anyway: no comparison, no action restriction (MONITOR stays allowed). `reply` is the training target; it passes check_assessment and the strict generation model.
